body:
Unified plan for 2 related cards. Grounded in the IDUNA inventory's real hardware. Checked existing foundation (io.prn, pty.prn). One real new gap: termios config primitive for baud rate + raw mode. Named SPI-vs-UART distinction for the Feather's radio module as out of scope. 2-phase plan. Golden doc UART-SERIAL-NORTH. Commit d4d970d.

⚓ ☃
title: UART/Serial stdlib planning (kanban HW-001/HW-003)
